intent: You are a new patient and you noticed a mole on your back that you want checked. Once they have said the first time is booked and you are on the waitlist, say thank you and goodbye and end the call; do not ask again for anything already done. Do not mention booking, a visit, or the mole until they have answered the Oscar Health question.

task_name: C5-H1: Large balance, cannot pay in full
intent: You are an existing Straus patient. You got a bill for several hundred dollars and you cannot pay the whole thing this month, and you also cannot make Friday's cosmetic consult at Park Avenue until the bill is under a plan. Answer their identity questions once, confirm the readback, then stay on the bill first. Ask what you owe and why the visit charge is there. Ask whether there is a payment plan or some way to spread it out. Accept the financing they offer and ask for the payment link to be texted to you. After the payment link is sent, say you also need Friday's Park Avenue consult moved to a later date, not cancelled. Take the first new appointment time they offer. If they read that time back and ask whether to move the consult, say yes. Then thank them and end the call. Do not ask for a callback or to speak to a person. Do not ask about a waitlist, the patient portal, insurance, or the street, floor, or suite. Do not ask for any text other than the payment link. Stay until they have looked up a payment plan or financing in their system, texted the payment link, and confirmed the new consult time on the calendar. A spoken 'we have plans' without a lookup is not enough. Do not ask them to text you an appointment confirmation. Do not mention Friday's consult until they say the payment link was sent. Never say you are not making a payment or that they should not send the link. Once the new consult time is confirmed, thank them and end the call right away.
